name: Birch Rock Camp
description_short: Overnight summer camp for boys in Waterford, Maine, offering full, half and two-week sessions. It also has a Cubs program for new campers ages 7-12 and a leadership program for ages 16-17.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations received in writing before April 1 can roll over to the next season or be refunded, minus the $1,500 non-refundable registration deposit. There is no tuition reduction for late arrival or early departure, and no refund if a camper is sent home for conduct. Half of tuition is due February 1 and the rest May 1. Credit card payments carry a 3.5% fee.

warnings: Boys only: the page refers to enrolling 'your son(s)' and to 'any boy'.
Listed session lengths don't always match the dates. For example, First Session June 26-July 24 is listed as 28 days, and Cubs sessions spanning 15 calendar days are listed as 13 days.

The menu and footer use different names for the same programs (Leadership Campers (16) vs Senior Campers (16+), Junior Counselor (17) vs Counselor in Training (17)), and the rates table lists Leadership as age 16-17.
About $100 of tuition covers uniforms, laundry, postage and trips. Transportation, medications, luggage shipping and other costs are extra. Brothers get a 10% discount after the first tuition.
The camp says all dates and tuition are subject to change.
